name: [CARRY!] Swiss Mountain: Saxer Lücke
desc:
The Saxer lücke is a 1,650M above sea level pass in the Alpstein Mountains between the Swiss cantons of Appenzell Innerrhoden and St. Gallen . It forms a north-south connection between the Schwende-Rüte district and the municipality of Sennwald in the St. Gallen Rhine Valley .

🛠️The cable car is temporarily remove because it has not been optimized.
⚠️Not recommended for low end devices, because it includes a showcase map that displays realistic visuals.
